3.
```{r}
library(dplyr)
dates <- c('2025-5-8 3:00pm', '2025-5-8 3:00pm')
zones <- c('US/Arizona', 'Pacific/Auckland')

data.frame(date=dates, zone=zones) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(date = ymd_hm(date, tz=zone))
```
4.
```{r, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

weather <- read.csv("Pulliam_Airport_Weather_Station.csv")

weather <- weather %>%
  mutate(DATE = ymd(DATE))

weather_5yrs <- weather %>%
  filter(DATE >= max(DATE, na.rm = TRUE) - years(5))

ggplot(weather_5yrs, aes(x = DATE, y = TMAX)) +
  geom_line()

```

5A.
```{r, warning = FALSE}
library(mosaicData)

data("Births78")
births_clean <- Births78 %>% select(date, births)
```

5B.
```{r}
ggplot(births_clean, aes(x = date, y = births)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "U.S. Births in 1978 by Date",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of Births"
  )
```
I kind of see like 2 different trends in the graph, I am actually not sure why the data has this trend.

5C.
```{r}
births_clean <- births_clean %>%
  mutate(dow = wday(date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE))
```

5D.
```{r}
ggplot(births_clean, aes(x = date, y = births, color = dow)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "U.S. Births in 1978 by Day of the Week",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of Births",
    color = "Day of Week"
  )
```
